Caller announcement and reading settings

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

All of these settings are in the Accessibility section of Settings.

Announce Caller reads out the caller’s name or number on an incoming call. When it is on, Incoming call announcement count, TTS Engine, Caller announcement speech rate, Caller announcement volume and Announcement audio channel appear.

Announcement audio channel has three options. Accessibility volume follows your screen reader’s volume. With Media volume the announcement plays even when the phone is silent, but not if the media volume is down. With Ringtone volume the announcement is not heard while the phone is silent.

Reset speed and volume returns the speed to the system default and the volume to 100.

Read contact number in recent calls and Read phone number in Contacts decide whether the number is read along with the contact’s name. Recent call announcement order chooses whether the call type is read before or after the name.

Phone number reading style sets how numbers are read: Accessible format (recommended), Digit by digit or Two-digit groups.

Key tone and Vibration give a sound and a vibration when you press the keys.
